objective: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.

description: My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great <class> like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!
Please, <name>.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
progress: Are you here to buy clothes?
completion: Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...
Oh, well. Fun will come later I guess.
